brand.name.hint: The company name: the serif wordmark in the nav, the title and the footer.

brand.tagline.hint: One line that says what you do and for whom. Used in search results.

brand.color.hint: Any CSS color: hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), oklab(), lab(), lch(), color(srgb ...) or color(display-p3 ...). It becomes the accent; the rest of the page stays warm neutral, and every pair is checked for AA contrast.

brand.format.hint: How the generated tokens are written in CSS. Both sites use the same one.

brand.location.hint: Where the company is based, shown in the footer.

link.app.hint: The full address of the private product app, for every main button. Running both on this computer: http://localhost:5173.

link.email.hint: Where people and partners write to.

nav.lead.hint: One or two words in front of the three step links in the nav, set lighter.

nav.guide.hint: One or two words for the link to the guide chapters.

nav.partners.ask: Nav label for the partners page
nav.partners.hint: One to three words for the link to /partners.

nav.cta.hint: Two or three words on the button that opens the product.

hero.title.hint: Six to twelve words that say what people can do with you, set in white over the pixel scene.

hero.sub.hint: One or two sentences on how it works.

hero.cta.hint: Two to four words on the light button that opens the product.

hero.second.hint: Two to four words on the glass button that copies the setup prompt.

hero.prompt.hint: The text the copy button puts on the clipboard: a prompt someone pastes into their own AI assistant to get started with you. Write {app} where the product URL goes; it is filled from link.app.

hero.art.hint: What the pixel scene shows: care (a clinic with a cross and a medical bag), learning (a school flag and a stack of books) or plain (just the landscape). The prop is painted in your brand color.

proof.1.hint: Something you can truthfully list: a standard you follow, a tool or system you work with, a partner or pilot site that agreed to be named. Never invent customers.

proof.2.hint: Something you can truthfully list: a standard you follow, a tool or system you work with, a partner or pilot site that agreed to be named. Never invent customers.

proof.4.hint: Something you can truthfully list: a standard you follow, a tool or system you work with, a partner or pilot site that agreed to be named. Never invent customers.

proof.count.hint: A true figure, shown in bold: a count, a percentage or a sourced statistic.

proof.line.hint: The words after the figure. If it is a statistic, name its source here in brackets.

platform.title.hint: Ten to sixteen words on what the product is. Wrap the second half in *stars* to set it in the lighter grey, like a two-tone headline.

mock.tabs.hint: Five short tab names across the top of the product picture, separated by commas.

mock.user.hint: A realistic first message someone sends the assistant.

mock.reply.hint: The assistant answer, two or three sentences. Wrap the last sentence in *stars* to set it in bold.

mock.agent.hint: The name of the assistant or worker shown running a task.

mock.task.hint: What it is doing right now, a short phrase.

mock.input.hint: The grey placeholder in the message box.
